no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Regen BioPharma's 10-K explicitly states 'No clinical trials on our product candidates have commenced.' HemaXellerate (autologous SVF for aplastic anemia) had FDA clinical hold lifted in 2015 but no Phase 1 study has been initiated. All other programs (dCellVax, tCellVax, DiffronC, DuraCar CAR-T, NR2F6 small-molecule agonists/antagonists including RG-NAH005) are in preclinical/IP-development stage as of the latest filing.
